title: Per-session amortization matrix by region and TTL
content:
Objective:
Provide a compact per-session cost matrix that ties token-level COGS, infra amortization, license overhead and spot/ondemand mix into a single per-session unit economics view. This is intended to complement per-token PPK sheets by showing how session shape and TTL (time-to-live / cache lifetime) change amortized costs for conversational apps.

SUMMARY TABLE (rows are sample buckets; calculated columns follow formulas below)

Columns:
Region | ModelFamily | CustomerTier | AvgTokensIn | AvgTokensOut | CallsPerSession | AvgTokensPerCall | SessionTTL(days) | SessionWeight% | GPUsecPer1kTokens | Spot% | InfraAmort/session(USD) | LicenseAmort/session(USD) | TokenCOGS/session(USD) | TotalCOGS/session(USD) | PriceCharged/session(USD) | Margin/session(USD) | Margin%

Rows (example buckets):
us-west-2 | 7B-quant | startup | 120 | 480 | 6 | 100 | 1 | 35 | 0.45 | 70 | 0.012 | 0.004 | 0.016 | 0.032 | 0.10 | 0.068 | 68%
us-west-2 | 13B-quant | midmarket | 220 | 950 | 8 | 150 | 7 | 28 | 0.60 | 60 | 0.028 | 0.010 | 0.040 | 0.078 | 0.28 | 0.202 | 72%
eu-central | 13B-quant | enterprise | 350 | 1200 | 10 | 155 | 30 | 12 | 0.60 | 50 | 0.085 | 0.025 | 0.060 | 0.170 | 0.45 | 0.280 | 62%
ap-southeast | 70B-fp16 | enterprise | 600 | 2600 | 12 | 260 | 14 | 8 | 0.95 | 40 | 0.220 | 0.060 | 0.420 | 0.700 | 1.20 | 0.500 | 42%

Key formulas (verbatim for sheet):
- AvgTokensPerCall = (AvgTokensIn + AvgTokensOut) / CallsPerSession
- GPUsecPerSession = (AvgTokensIn + AvgTokensOut) / 1000 * GPUsecPer1kTokens
- InfraAmort/session = (BaseInfraHourlyCost * GPUsecPerSession / 3600) * (1 - SpotDiscount * Spot%) + AttachMiscAmort / SessionsPerDayAdjusted
- LicenseAmort/session = ModelLicenseDaily / SessionsPerDayAdjusted
- TokenCOGS/session = TokenCentsPer1k * (AvgTokensIn + AvgTokensOut) / 1000
- TotalCOGS/session = InfraAmort/session + LicenseAmort/session + TokenCOGS/session + NetOpsSurcharge
- Margin/session = PriceCharged/session - TotalCOGS/session
- Margin% = Margin/session / PriceCharged/session

Assumptions and parameter references (keys used in formulas):
- BaseInfraHourlyCost: USD 2.40 for p4d-like, 0.95 for A100-80GB, 0.45 for smaller quantized families; sheet reference 'infra_cost_map' by model family.
- GPUsecPer1kTokens: empirical kernels table (conservative) -> 7B quant=0.45s, 13B quant=0.60s, 70B fp16=0.95s.
- SpotDiscount: 0.55 (spot reduces infra hourly by 55% on average vs reserved).
- AttachMiscAmort: per-session attach costs (e.g., network egress provisioning, NAT, embedding cache) default = 0.002 USD/session for light sessions, up to 0.03 for heavy enterprise.
- SessionsPerDayAdjusted = (24 * 3600) / (GPUsecPerSession * concurrencyFactor); concurrencyFactor = 6 baseline, higher for bursty multi-tenant pools.
- ModelLicenseDaily: 0.00 for permissive open families, 5.00 USD/day for some enterprise-licensed weights, variable by family.
- TokenCentsPer1k: by region (us-west=0.015 USD per 1k, eu-central=0.018, ap-southeast=0.025) capturing amortized inference software + networking per token.
- NetOpsSurcharge: flat 0.002 USD/session to account for request routing/tracing costs.

Sensitivity slices included in sheet (tabs):
1) Spot mix sweep: Spot% from 20->90% by 10pt increments, hold sessions constant. Visual: per-session infra amortization curve.
2) TTL decay impact: show SessionsPerDayAdjusted increase when SessionTTL > 7 (caching makes more repeated calls use cached KV), reduce effective GPUsecPerSession by 10-40% depending on TTL.
3) Price elasticity: compute break-even price per session for target margin bands (10/25/50%).
4) Model replacement scenario: swap 70B-fp16 -> 13B-quant with latency-sensitive tail; recalc margin and customer price uplift required to keep same latency SLO.

Quick insights from preliminary runs (numbers derive from the example rows above):
- Small startup sessions (short TTL, small tokens) show very high margin % despite small absolute dollar margin; cost volatility driven primarily by spot mix assumptions.
- Enterprise long-ttl sessions (sessions reused over 14–30 days) show lower token COGS per session but much higher license amortization and infra amortization due to pinned capacity; these buckets are sensitive to sessions/day assumptions and concurrency factor.
- Region differentials push token COGS by ~40% between us-west and ap-southeast; pricing or SLO adjustments needed for APAC-heavy customers on larger families.

Open questions / actions for next iteration:
- Pull accurate SessionsPerDay metrics by customer-tier from prod telemetry (simon: can you extract sample of 100 enterprise accounts for last 90 days?).
- Replace conservative GPUsec estimates with microbenchmark results from running kernels on dedicated infra image (engineering: Marco).
- Add a "session shape cluster" tab with 5 archetypes derived from real request traces and weight the amortization by observed cluster mix.
- Evaluate adding a per-session SLA surcharge (e.g., +0.02 for 99.9 SLA on dedicated GPUs) and model its impact on margin and price buckets.

Recommendations (short-term, 30d):
- Add TTL-driven cache incentives in the pricing catalog: offer 10% discount for customers that enable session persistence > 7 days (reduces token COGS by reusing KV cache).
- Region-specific price uplift for APAC on large families: +15–20% suggested to maintain >= 45% margin on 70B-class families.
- Introduce a startup tier template: default to 7B-quant, recommended concurrency cap and spot-heavy routing to preserve margin while keeping price accessible.

Appendix: Example sensitivity table excerpt (columns: Spot%, InfraAmort/session USD for us-west 13B-quant enterprise row):
Spot% | 30 | 50 | 70 | 90
InfraAmort/session | 0.110 | 0.072 | 0.055 | 0.041

Notes on provenance: this sheet is a working artifact synthesized from token-level PPK sheets, hosted-api traffic shapes (internal telemetry), and infra hourly pricing models. Intentionally compact to be a light tool for pricing conversations with sales and product.
